parts.name: Monocoque
parts.role: survival cell / chassis tub with nose and cockpit opening
parts.notes: Reuse registered version 3 unchanged: do not redesign, move or modify.

parts.name: Front wing
parts.role: front wing: main plane, flap(s), endplates; ahead of the front axle
parts.notes: Reuse registered version 3 unchanged: do not redesign, move or modify.

parts.name: Floor
parts.role: floor plate under the car with rear diffuser ramp
parts.notes: Reuse registered version 2 unchanged: do not redesign, move or modify.

parts.name: Rear wing
parts.role: rear wing: main plane, flap, endplates, central support
parts.notes: Reuse registered version 2 unchanged: do not redesign, move or modify.

parts.name: Wheel front left
parts.role: front-left wheel and tyre on the front axle (X=0), +Y side
parts.notes: Axle along the part-local Y axis through the local origin (wheel centre), rotationally symmetric about it. Tyre cylinder radius 360 from local Y -150 to +150 with 40 mm rounded shoulders, near-black. Recessed silver rim face (dia 460, 30 deep) on the outboard (+Y) face. Hub boss on the inboard (-Y) side: radius 90 from local Y -150 to -210; its end face at Y -210 is the suspension contact plane. One connected solid.

parts.name: Wheel front right
parts.role: front-right wheel and tyre on the front axle (X=0), -Y side

parts.name: Wheel rear left
parts.role: rear-left wheel and tyre on the rear axle, +Y side
parts.notes: Axle along the part-local Y axis through the local origin (wheel centre), rotationally symmetric about it. Tyre cylinder radius 370 from local Y -190 to +190 with 40 mm rounded shoulders, near-black. Recessed silver rim face (dia 480, 30 deep) on the outboard (+Y) face. Hub boss on the inboard (-Y) side: radius 90 from local Y -190 to -250; end face at Y -250 is the suspension contact plane. One connected solid.

parts.name: Wheel rear right
parts.role: rear-right wheel and tyre on the rear axle, -Y side

parts.name: Front suspension left
parts.role: front-left suspension links: monocoque to WHL-FL
parts.notes: One connected dark-grey solid, 30 mm square beams. Lower wishbone: inboard nodes (80,145,120) and (-280,210,120), outboard node (0,590,300). Upper wishbone: inboard (80,145,185),(-280,210,185), outboard (0,590,420). Pushrod from (40,590,330) to (-200,195,190). Inboard ends embedded ~15 mm (max 20) into monocoque wall. Outboard ends end in flat pads exactly on plane Y=590, all within 90 mm of (0,360) in XZ, touching the hub boss. Join everything via the outboard upright pad.

parts.name: Front suspension right
parts.role: front-right suspension links: monocoque to WHL-FR

parts.name: Rear suspension left
parts.role: rear-left suspension links: car body to WHL-RL
parts.notes: One connected dark-grey solid, 30 mm square beams. Lower wishbone: inboard (130,432,180),(-130,432,180), outboard (0,510,310). Upper: inboard (130,432,470),(-130,432,470), outboard (0,510,430). Pushrod (50,510,340) to (-100,435,460). Inboard ends embedded ~15 mm (max 20) into monocoque side wall (|Y|~447 there). Outboard flat pads exactly on plane Y=510, within 90 mm of (0,370) in XZ, joined by a small upright pad touching the hub boss.

parts.name: Rear suspension right
parts.role: rear-right suspension links: car body to WHL-RR

parts.name: Sidepod left
parts.role: left sidepod bodywork with radiator inlet, beside the monocoque
parts.notes: Red lofted solid, local X 0 (front) to -2250 (rear), bottom flat at local Z 0 on the floor top. Inner wall Y: 280 at X0, 372 at -700, 426 at -1900, 431 at -2250 (embeds <=25 into monocoque). Outer wall Y: ~620 at X0, 700 at -500, 540 at -2250. Top Z: 370 at X0, 390 at -1100, 270 at -2250, top edges filleted ~60. Front-face inlet pocket ~200(Y) x 150(Z), 120 deep, centred Y~460, Z~220. Modest outer lower undercut (~60 mm) only if robust.

parts.name: Sidepod right
parts.role: right sidepod bodywork with radiator inlet, beside the monocoque

parts.name: Engine cover
parts.role: power unit / engine cover behind the cockpit, above the floor
parts.notes: Red single solid, base plane local Z 0 (embedded into monocoque top, max 60). Airbox: local X -250..0, |Y|<=140, up to Z 320 with rounded top and a front intake opening (~160 wide x 120 high, 150 deep pocket) in the X=0 face. Shark-fin spine fused behind: local X -1150..-250, |Y|<=40, top Z from ~300 at X -250 tapering to 120 at X -1150. Stays >=100 mm ahead of the rear wing.

parts.name: Halo
parts.role: halo cockpit protection hoop over the cockpit opening
parts.notes: Dark grey single solid. U-hoop of 40 mm bars: rear feet at local (-860, +/-280, 0) rising to a hoop top at Z ~160 (bar centre) curving round to the front at local X ~-80, Y 0; central front pillar from the hoop down to its foot at local (0,0,0). All foot bottoms flat on local Z=0 (rim top plane), inside the rim ring, touching the monocoque.

parts.name: Mirror left
parts.role: left rear-view mirror housing on its stalk beside the cockpit
parts.notes: Black single solid. Stalk 30x30 along +Y from local Y 385 (embedded ~10, max 15, into monocoque side wall at |Y|~395) to Y 480, centred X 0, Z 0. Housing box 40 (X) x 160 (Y) x 80 (Z) centred at (0,560,0), small edge fillets. Keep >=20 mm from halo and sidepod.

parts.name: Mirror right
parts.role: right rear-view mirror housing on its stalk beside the cockpit

assumptions: Reused parts keep their registered pose at the VCS origin and registered envelopes (MON-001 Z max 790 per registry).
Monocoque side-wall half-width is linearly interpolated between the brief's stations to set inboard embed depths.
Wheel rim face diameters 460 (front) / 480 (rear), 30 mm recess, 40 mm tyre shoulder radius.
Front pickups: lower Z 120, upper Z 185 at X +80 and -280; outboard nodes at Z 300/420.
Rear pickups: lower Z 180, upper Z 470 at X -3270/-3530; outboard nodes at Z 310/430.
Sidepod outer half-width about 620 at the front face, inlet pocket centred Y~460, Z~250 in VCS, undercut ~60 mm.
Halo top bar centreline at Z 900 (outer surface 920); front pillar 40 mm wide.
Mirror stalk 30x30 mm, housing centre Y 560, Z 540; engine intake opening about 160x120 mm.
